summary: Successful architecture review completed. Due to MISSING_RUNTIME_FORENSICS, all strategies must remain in SHADOW evaluation. The structural invariants in strategy_lab.py, sibot.py and solana_sibot.py correctly enforce execution economics (gas limits, priority fees, and roundtrip loss constraints), but fresh execution evidence is required to quantify real slippage, infrastructure failure rates versus strategy losses, and executable PnL before any promotion can occur.
